method: Each frontage was measured on its rectified wall image (facade-priority-v15/crops/rectified: pixel columns are metres along the frontage, rows metres above the base, 1 m grid). The image scale is recovered from two cues, the building's visible corners against the frontage's LiDAR wall pieces and the wall top against the LiDAR wall height; a disagreement means the footprint runs over a neighbour, and the reading then describes the image across the whole footprint frontage. Head shapes, relief arches, piers, spandrels, parapet outlines, cornice profiles, ornaments, literal sign text and wall colours were read from the same images. Everything is a visual measurement from one or two dated street panoramas; nothing is surveyed.
